papers.title_en: INSPIRE: A Benchmark for Instruction-Aware Speech Retrieval
papers.evidence: 首个面向指令感知语音检索的基准
papers.tldr: 现有语音检索依赖固定相似度匹配，难以适应用户多样意图。为此提出INSPIRE——首个指令感知语音检索基准，用自然语言指令动态定义相关性，涵盖语义、说话人、风格、环境声等维度。实验评估四种主流检索范式，发现无方法能全面胜任：文本方法语义好但副语言弱，语音方法声学好但指令遵循差。该基准揭示统一架构需求，为未来研究提供评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: Existing speech retrieval systems rely on fixed similarity matching and cannot adapt to diverse user intents. We introduce INSPIRE, the first benchmark for instruction-aware speech retrieval, in which natural-language instructions dynamically specify relevance criteria, including semantic content, speaker identity, speaking style, environmental sounds, and their combinations. We evaluate four retrieval paradigms: large audio-language models, cascaded pipelines, self-supervised speech models, and contrastive audio-language models. Our results reveal that no current method robustly handles all retrieval intents. Text-based approaches perform relatively better at semantic retrieval but struggle with paralinguistic attributes, while speech-based models are moderately better at capturing acoustic properties but falter at following instructions. These findings highlight the need for unified architectures capable of instruction-aware speech retrieval.

papers.title_en: VoxAudio: Vocalized Audio Synthesis via Multi-Reward Autoregressive Flow Matching
papers.authors: Wenxiang Guo, Changhao Pan, Ziyue Jiang, Zhou Zhao, Fei Wu
papers.evidence: 在环境声中嵌入清晰语音的文本到音频合成，直接匹配文本到音频合成方法。
papers.tldr: 语音化音频合成需在环境声景中嵌入可理解语音，但现有T2A系统要么将引语降为难以辨认的人声嘟囔，要么交给独立TTS后混合，失去对语音发生时刻及其与场景互动的控制。为此提出VoxAudio，一种因果自回归流匹配模型：在架构上采用分块因果分解与随机块边界预训练，支持滑动窗口流式推理和KV缓存；在偏好上通过多奖励负感知微调(NFT)同时优化语义保真、语言准确、美学质量与时间接地；在数据上构建了带逐字转录和时间区间的VoxCorpus及带间隔标注的VoxBench。在四个基准上验证了该方法在生成质量和效率上的优越性，并开源代码与示例。
papers.abstract_en: Vocalized audio synthesis, the task of generating audio in which intelligible speech is embedded within an environmental soundscape, underpins applications such as podcast production and video dubbing. Existing Text-to-Audio (T2A) systems either reduce quoted speech to unintelligible vocal murmur or delegate it to a separate TTS model with post-hoc mixing, which forfeits control over when speech occurs and how it interacts with the scene. We present VoxAudio, a causal autoregressive flow matching model that addresses this problem from three complementary aspects. At the architecture level, chunk-wise causal factorization with independent per-chunk noise levels lets audio be emitted through sliding-window streaming inference with KV caching at variable target durations; to enable inference at arbitrary chunk granularities, we further pretrain the model with randomized chunk boundaries. At the preference level, multi-reward Negative-aware FineTuning (NFT) jointly optimizes semantic fidelity, linguistic accuracy, aesthetic quality, and temporal grounding At the data level, to supply the missing supervision for vocal content, we build VoxCorpus, a large-scale corpus whose captions quote the verbatim transcript of embedded speech with time intervals, and VoxBench, an interval-annotated benchmark with a temporal-grounding metric. Experiments on four benchmarks spanning general audio, speech, and unified vocalized audio validate the effectiveness and efficiency of VoxAudio. Our code and demos are available at https://voxaudio.github.io.

papers.title_en: Adding Voice Cloning to Text-to-Audio-Video Models with a Single Zero-Initialised Layer
papers.authors: Ivan Mikheev, Viacheslav Vasilev, Anna Dmitrienko, Alexey Letunovskiy, Ivan Kirillov, Kirill Chernyshev, Denis Dimitrov
papers.evidence: 将声音克隆集成到文本到音视频生成中，直接属于文本到音频合成方法。
papers.tldr: 文本到音视频（T2AV）生成模型可产出视频与同步音轨，但无法控制配音者。作者在音频骨干上仅增加一个零初始化线性层，进行短训练，并利用参考录音的双信号（扩散潜变量前置与全局说话人嵌入调制）实现语音克隆。在674对说话人-文本基准上，5B模型在ECAPA-TDNN等三个验证网络上取得最高SECS，显著优于五个强基线；音频路径可脱离视频单独运行，获得约30倍加速。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation models produce a video and its soundtrack from a textual description, but offer no control over whose voice speaks in the output. We show that a base T2AV model can be turned into a voice-cloning model by adding a single zero-initialized linear layer on top of its audio backbone, fine-tuning for a comparatively short training schedule, and conditioning on a short reference recording at inference time. The reference is injected through two complementary signals: its diffusion latents are prepended to the audio stream, and a global speaker embedding modulates token of the target audio. On a benchmark of 674 speaker-text pairs spanning 30 speakers we compare against five strong voice-cloning text-to-speech baselines: our enhanced 5B model attains the highest speaker-encoder cosine similarity (SECS) across three independent verification networks (ECAPA-TDNN, WavLM-SV, Resemblyzer), statistically significantly outperforming every baseline. A side product of the architecture is that the audio path can be evaluated without the video path at inference time, yielding a ~30x speed-up over the full audio-video diffusion loop while preserving the voice-cloning behaviour.

papers.title_en: Iterative Self-Learning for Expressive Text-to-Speech Synthesis
papers.authors: Nicholas Sanders, Gustav Eje Henter, Simon King, Korin Richmond
papers.evidence: 表现力语音合成与半监督迭代自学习
papers.tldr: 表达性TTS依赖显式条件标签以实现可解释控制，但人工标注代价高昂，现有半监督方法仅应对语音-文本配对或转录不足，未触及标签稀缺这一瓶颈。为此，提出迭代自学习（ISL）框架，基于Invert-Classify无分类器方法，通过反转冻结生成模型为未标注语音迭代生成离散表达性伪标签并重训练，逐步提升标签质量与合成性能。在词级显著性和语句级情感两个低资源任务中，ISL的伪标签准确率显著高于单遍基线，且标签遵循度与合成音质均获得改进，经客观指标和听感测试验证。在数据最稀缺条件下，ISL模型逼近全监督水平，为低资源表达性TTS提供了可行的梯度式自学习方案。
papers.abstract_en: Expressive text-to-speech (TTS) systems that use explicit conditioning labels provide direct and interpretable control over expressive attributes, in contrast to reference-based or prompting-based approaches, but require labeled data. Obtaining these labels at scale is costly and time-consuming, yet no prior semi-supervised framework addresses this specific bottleneck. Existing semi-supervised TTS methods instead target scarcity of paired speech-text data or transcriptions. To address the scarcity of expressive labels, we propose an Iterative Self-Learning (ISL) framework for expressive TTS, built on Invert-Classify, a classifier-free method that recovers discrete expressive labels by inverting a frozen generative model. The framework iteratively pseudo-labels unlabeled speech using the current model, retrains on the combined labeled and pseudo-labeled data, and repeats, progressively refining label quality and synthesis. We validate on two expressive tasks, word-level prominence and utterance-level emotion, across multiple low-resource data splits. We find that iterative refinement can improve pseudo-label accuracy over single-pass baselines. Furthermore, we observe that these improvements in pseudo-labeling of expressivity translate to gains in expressive label adherence and synthesis quality, confirmed by objective metrics and human listening tests. In the most data-scarce conditions, ISL-trained models outperform single-pass pseudo-labeling and further approach fully supervised performance, demonstrating that gradient-based ISL is an effective solution to expressive label scarcity in low-resource TTS.

papers.title_en: Cached LLM Probability Retrieval for Speech Recognition
papers.authors: Sheng Li, Takahiro Shinozaki, Tatsuya Kawahara
papers.evidence: 使用缓存大模型概率检索改进语音识别
papers.tldr: LLM在ASR重打分中需逐条评估N-best，代价高昂。本文提出缓存LLM概率检索：离线用教师LLM为上下文-目标对生成概率，识别时通过查缓存、回退及可选打分利用这些概率。该方法免训练，适配现有识别器。评测显示其在39个设置中28个优于1-pass ASR，且非oracle错误更低；上下文长度8时收益最大，是一种轻量有效的ASR适配手段。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) enhance automatic speech recognition (ASR) by providing linguistic priors; however, their direct rescoring is costly because it requires evaluating every N-best hypothesis. This paper introduces "cached LLM probability retrieval," which involves querying a local teacher LLM offline to obtain next-token probabilities for ASR-relevant context-target pairs. These probabilities are then utilized during recognition via cache lookups, backoff strategies, and optional scoring for significant misses. The method is training-free and can integrate with existing recognizers without requiring modifications to acoustic models. Evaluations across various ASR models reveal that cached retrieval outperforms 1-pass ASR in 28 of 39 settings and achieves lower non-oracle errors. Context length analysis indicates that benefits peak at a context length of 8, suggesting that cached probability retrieval is an effective and lightweight ASR adaptation method, in contrast to the heavy training required for Generative Error Correction (GER) or knowledge distillation (KD).

papers.title_en: FireRedTTS3: Unified Speech Generation and Editing with Semantically Enriched Speech Representations
papers.authors: Feiyu Shen, Kun Xie, Yichen Wu, Ziqi Dai, Yichen Han, Junjie Li, Xuelong Geng, Fenglong Xie, Lei Xie, Xu Tang, Yao Hu
papers.evidence: 基于语义增强表示的连续自回归语音合成与编辑，直接匹配语音合成需求。
papers.tldr: 连续自回归TTS模型虽能保留丰富声学细节并支持指令控制，但存在误差累积问题，现有缓解方案往往引入额外模块或复杂架构。FireRedTTS3利用冻结的音频编码器作为语义教师，在表示层正则化特征空间，从而改善文本-语音对齐并稳定生成。该方法提供Base和Instruct两个变体，分别针对多语多方言零样本克隆与统一指令控制语音生成/编辑。实验表明其在多个基准上取得最优，以简单架构实现高保真、可控的语音生成与编辑。
papers.abstract_en: Recent continuous autoregressive TTS models operate directly on continuous speech representations, preserving rich acoustic details while leveraging the instruction-following capabilities of text LLMs. This paradigm opens new possibilities for voice cloning, instruction-controlled voice design, and speech editing, but remains susceptible to error accumulation during autoregressive generation. Existing solutions often require additional semantic modules, multi-stage tokenizer training pipelines, or complex autoregressive architectures. In this work, we propose FireRedTTS3, a simple yet effective speech generation and editing framework that mitigates error accumulation at the representation level. Specifically, we leverage a frozen Audio Encoder trained on diverse speech understanding tasks as a semantic teacher to regularize the audio feature space. This improves text-speech alignment and stabilizes autoregressive generation while keeping the overall system simple. FireRedTTS3 provides two variants: FireRedTTS3-Base for multilingual and multi-dialect zero-shot voice cloning, and FireRedTTS3-Instruct for unified voice cloning, instruction-controlled voice design, and speech editing. Experiments show that FireRedTTS3-Base achieves the best average speech intelligibility and speaker similarity among compared systems on Seed-TTS-Eval and MiniMax-MLS-Test, while FireRedTTS3-Instruct outperforms competing systems on InstructTTSEval and Ming-Freeform-Audio-Edit. These results demonstrate that semantically enriched continuous speech representations, combined with a simple architecture, enable stable, controllable, and high-fidelity speech generation and editing. Code and models are available at https://github.com/FireRedTeam/FireRedTTS3.

papers.title_en: DuplexGen: Decoupling Content, Timing, and Acoustics for Synthetic Dialogue Speech
papers.authors: Pengcheng Wang, Sheng Li, Jiyi Li, Takahiro Shinozaki
papers.evidence: 对话语音合成框架，生成自然的对话语音
papers.tldr: 现有对话合成往往先确定内容，再用规则手工插入打断、重叠和反馈，对话时序是预设而非交互涌现。DuplexGen解耦内容、时序与声学：LLM先写脚本，两个全双工模型实时互听表演，使时序自然涌现，再用高保真TTS重渲染而不改动时序。基于此构建医患对话语料并验证，生成虚拟对话的动态比传统拼接法更贴近真实互动，为对话语音合成提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic conversational speech has become an important resource for developing and evaluating conversational speech systems. However, existing dialogue synthesis pipelines typically generate dialogue content first and then insert interruptions, overlap, and backchannels using handcrafted markers or timing rules, making conversational timing prescribed rather than interaction-driven. We present DuplexGen, a dialogue synthesis framework that explicitly decouples content, timing, and acoustics. An LLM first generates the dialogue script, and then two full-duplex conversational models perform the script while listening to each other in real time. This allows conversational timing to emerge naturally while preserving the scripted content. Finally, a high-fidelity text-to-speech model re-renders the interaction without altering its timing. As a demonstration of the proposed framework, we construct a patient--clinician conversational speech corpus with construction-time annotations, including word timestamps, speaker activity, overlap regions, and interaction events. Experimental results show that the proposed framework produces conversational dynamics closer to real dialogue than conventional stitching-based synthesis.

papers.title_en: Speaker-Normalized Semantic Speech Tokens via Iterative S2U-T2U Refinement
papers.authors: Hanlin Zhang, Daxin Tan, Dehua Tao, Chengxi Deng, Xiao Chen, Linqi Song
papers.evidence: 说话人归一化语义语音token与语音转换技术直接相关
papers.tldr: 语义语音标记应保留语言内容，同时抑制说话人和时长等声学变化，但现有分词器常继承这些干扰。针对此问题，本文提出迭代语义标记纯化（ISTP），通过交替执行语音到单元（S2U）与文本到单元（T2U）训练，以文本可预测性为准则，迭代式地用T2U解码结果监督新S2U模型的CTC目标，逐步对齐标记分布，使标记空间仅保留文本可恢复的信息。在普通话和英语上的实验表明，该方法显著提高S2U-T2U一致性；精炼标记用于语音转换和语音合成时可懂度高，转换语速更贴近参考，跨说话人一致性增强，且探针可恢复的说话人信息显著减少。这些结果验证了其作为说话人归一化语义标记纯化方法的有效性与实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic speech tokens should preserve linguistic content while suppressing speaker- and duration-dependent variation inherited from acoustic inputs. We propose Iterative Semantic Token Purification (ISTP), an alternating speech-to-unit (S2U) and text-to-unit (T2U) training procedure guided by text predictability. Starting from an initial S2U tokenizer, each iteration trains a T2U model on its deduplicated token sequences. The decoded T2U predictions then serve as connectionist temporal classification targets for a newly initialized S2U model, whose outputs supervise the next T2U model. This cycle progressively aligns the two token generators and biases the token space toward information recoverable from text. Experiments on Mandarin and English show substantially improved S2U--T2U agreement. Independently trained de-tokenizers further show that the refined S2U and T2U tokens retain sufficient content for high-intelligibility voice conversion and text-to-speech synthesis. In voice conversion, the generated speaking rate follows the reference more closely. The refined tokens also exhibit substantially improved cross-speaker consistency and reduced probe-recoverable speaker information.

papers.title_en: The Last Mile of Deepfake Speech Detection: An Industry-Academia Experience Report
papers.authors: Anton Firc, Kamil Malinka, Vojtěch Staněk, Miroslav Hlaváček, Marek Bartoň
papers.evidence: 讨论合成语音检测基准的局限性与实际部署障碍
papers.tldr: 深度伪造语音检测基准虽达亚1%错误率，但真实部署仍受未知攻击、信道失配和数据分布偏移影响。基于与Phonexia三年的产学研合作，发现多数公共基准未获商用许可、真实输入为长时长且编码退化的录音、以及校准后的似然比分数难向客户解释等障碍。本文不提出新模型，而是提议制定可商用数据集共享标准、构建真实部署基准、设计非专家可据以行动的风险分数。这些观察源自单一项目，仍需在其他场景中检验。
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic speech detection benchmarks now report sub-1% error rates on some in-domain evaluations, yet performance degrades under unseen attacks, channel mismatch, and distribution shift. Based on a three-year effort with Phonexia, a commercial speaker-recognition vendor, we report barriers encountered while building and deploying a detector. Many public benchmarks are not licensed for commercial model development. Real inputs are not four-second clean clips but long, codec-degraded, sometimes partially synthetic recordings. And when a calibrated system returns a log-likelihood ratio of 2.5, no one can tell the customer what it means for their decision. Rather than proposing a new model, we connect these barriers to concrete research and coordination proposals: shared standards for commercially usable datasets, realistic deployment benchmarks, and scores that non-experts can act on. These observations come from one project and should be tested in other settings.

papers.title_en: SpeechSense: A Paralinguistic-Focused Dataset for Fine-Grained Speech Sentiment Analysis
papers.authors: Shicheng Ma, Wenqian Cui, Irwin King
papers.evidence: 为细粒度语音情感分析构建数据集
papers.tldr: 语音情感分析需捕捉“怎么说”而非仅“说什么”，但现有方法多级联ASR与文本分析，丢失韵律等声学特征；且标签多集中于基本情绪，缺乏细粒度人际立场。为此提出SpeechSense数据集，定义8类可主要通过韵律线索检测的人际立场，采用高保真语音合成与人工验证构建。实验表明，能访问声学特征的多模态模型显著优于文本基线，证明声学线索对识别微妙说话人态度的重要价值。该数据集填补了细粒度语音情感分析空白，推动声学线索研究。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI have revolutionized speech processing, yet effective speech understanding requires discerning not just what is said, but how it is said. Speech Sentiment Analysis plays a critical role in decoding these paralinguistic cues for diverse real-world applications such as recruitment and customer service. However, existing Speech Sentiment Analysis research faces two primary limitations. First, dominant approaches rely on text-centric pipelines that cascade Automatic Speech Recognition with text analysis. This process inevitably discards essential acoustic features like prosody and tone, failing to capture attitudinal meanings in acoustically ambiguous utterances. Second, current benchmarks suffer from a mismatch in label granularity, prioritizing basic emotions (e.g., happy, sad) over the nuanced interpersonal stances (e.g., confident, impatient) necessary for social sensitivity. To address these limitations, we propose a novel dataset, SpeechSense, for fine-grained speech sentiment analysis. Specifically, we define a specialized 8-class taxonomy of interpersonal stances detectable primarily through prosodic cues beyond lexical content alone. We then construct a curated dataset based on this taxonomy, built from high-fidelity speech synthesis and rigorous human validation. Comprehensive experiments across multi-modal LLMs, text-only LLMs, and speech encoders demonstrate that models with acoustic access consistently outperform text-only baselines. These results empirically validate the primacy of acoustic cues in detecting subtle speaker attitudes, highlighting the necessity of SpeechSense. Dataset and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/Sher13cked/SpeechSense.

papers.title_en: Trajectory Dynamics in Self-Supervised Learning Latent Space for Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.evidence: 利用自监督潜空间时间轨迹动力学进行音频伪造检测
papers.tldr: 语音产生受生理学约束，在自监督学习模型的潜空间中形成结构化轨迹动态。我们假设合成语音会违反这些动态，并仅用真实语音训练因果LSTM预测器来检测。该动态方法在六个基准上取得竞争性或最先进性能，尤其在跨域任务上显著优于静态池化，证实了时间生理约束提供的检测信号超越了话语级统计。
papers.abstract_en: Human speech production is constrained by physiology, giving rise to characteristic temporal structure on acoustic signals. We hypothesise that these constraints manifest as structured trajectory dynamics in the latent space of Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) models, and that synthetic speech violates them detectably. To test this hypothesis, we train a causal Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) next-frame predictor on bonafide speech only (Stage 1), using the deepfake-specialised SSL backbone Wav2Vec2-Large-AntiDeepfake, and compare against a static global-average-pooling baseline using identical features, thus isolating the contribution of temporal modelling. A supervised Stage 2, which trains a Multi-Layer Perceptron on the frozen LSTM internal states using labelled data, is included to characterise the role of spoof supervision. Our system achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across six benchmarks: ASVspoof 2019/2021, Codecfake, In-the-Wild, MLAAD-EN, and Deepfake-Eval-2024, including best published EER on ASVspoof 2021 (0.75\%) and, notably, Stage 1 trained on bonafide speech only surpasses the published supervised baseline from the same backbone on DE2024 (30.35\%). On near-domain benchmarks, static and dynamic approaches perform comparably. On harder cross-corpus benchmarks with diverse synthesis methods, trajectory dynamics provide substantial gains, confirming that temporal physiological constraints carry detection signal beyond utterance-level statistics.

papers.title_en: S2Dialog: Multimodal Dialogue Retrieval with Semantic and Acoustic-Style Modeling
papers.authors: Xueqi Wang, Zhigang Wang, Runqing Zhang, Zhenqi Jia, Junfeng Zhao
papers.evidence: 对话级声学风格建模与检索，服务会话语音合成等下游任务
papers.tldr: 多模态对话检索旨在从对话库中检索与目标对话在文本语义和声学风格上相似的对话，对情感识别、对话系统等任务至关重要。现有方法多限于话语级或单模态匹配，难以捕捉整段对话的全局语义与风格一致性。为此提出S2Dialog框架，包含对话级文本检索器和声学检索器，并引入对话级文本-声学对比学习以对齐相似对话。在DailyTalk数据集上取得优异检索性能，验证了对话级多模态联合检索的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal dialogue retrieval aims to retrieve dialogues from multimodal dialogue banks that are similar to a target dialogue in terms of both textual semantics and acoustic conversational styles. Such dialogue-level retrieval is crucial for many dialogue-related tasks, including Emotion Recognition in Conversation, Spoken Dialogue Systems, and Conversational Speech Synthesis, where external dialogue examples can provide valuable semantic and stylistic references. However, existing retrieval methods are still largely limited to utterance-level or unimodal matching, and often fail to capture the global semantic coherence and stylistic consistency of an entire dialogue. To address this gap, we propose S2Dialog, a unified framework for dialogue-level semantic-style retrieval from multimodal dialogue banks. Specifically, S2Dialog consists of a Dialogue-level Textual Retriever and a Dialogue-level Acoustic Retriever, which encode the textual and acoustic modalities of a dialogue into dialogue-level representations, respectively. To further enhance multimodal retrieval, we introduce Dialogue-level Textual-Acoustic Contrastive Learning, which aligns semantically and stylistically similar dialogues while distinguishing unrelated ones. Extensive experiments on the multimodal dialogue dataset DailyTalk demonstrate that S2Dialog achieves outstanding retrieval performance.

papers.title_en: Separate First, Then Associate: A Two-Stage Approach for Real-World Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement
papers.evidence: 面向真实世界的先分离后关联音视频语音增强
papers.tldr: 真实世界音视频语音增强面临说话人重叠、混响和视觉退化等挑战，现有方法在模拟数据上表现好但实际性能下降。为此提出解耦的两阶段方法：先使用仅音频模型将混合语音分离为多个独立说话人信号，再利用音视频CLIP模型通过跨模态相似度匹配，选择与目标说话人面部视频最一致的分离语音。在挑战数据集上的评估验证了该方法的有效性，为实际应用提供了可靠方案。
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) aims at extracting target speech from multi-speaker mixtures by exploiting visual cues. Although recent studies have reported strong performance on simulated datasets, the performance, however, often drops dramatically when they are applied to real-world audio-visual recordings. To bridge this gap, the Real-World AVSE Challenge held in the ISCSLP 2026 conference calls for participants to design a practical solution for AVSE under real-world conditions, where speaker overlap, acoustic interferences, room reverberation and visual degradations naturally co-exist. In our submission to the challenge, we propose a decoupled separation-then-association approach. It consists of two stages: a separation stage in which a trained, audio-only model (i.e., not using visual cues) is used to separate input multi-speaker mixture to individual speaker signals, followed by an association stage, where an audio-visual CLIP model is used to identify the separated speech signal with the highest similarity with the target speaker's facial video via cross-modal similarity matching. Evaluation results on the challenge dataset show the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

papers.title_en: CineDub: Scaling End-to-End Video Dubbing to Multi-Speaker Dialogues with Coherent Sound Effects
papers.authors: Yusheng Dai, Kangdi Wang, Baolong Gao, Yuxuan Jiang, Weiqiang Wang, Qiuhong Ke, Jianfei Cai
papers.evidence: 用统一扩散模型从文本合成多说话人配音与连贯音效
papers.tldr: 野外视频配音受限于分层方法的脆弱预处理和整体方法的时序对齐与说话人歧义。本文提出CineDub，一种统一扩散模型，采用隐式耦合整体条件范式，无需人脸裁剪或说话人分离即可完成多说话人对话配音。结合环境到语言课程学习与解耦文本分支控制，联合生成语音与连贯音效。在多个基准上达到最先进性能，并发布两个野外基准。
papers.abstract_en: Automatic video dubbing in the wild remains fundamentally limited by two competing constraints: hierarchical methods depend on brittle, multi-stage preprocessing pipelines that severely restrict data scalability and practical deployment, while holistic approaches operating on uncropped video suffer from weak temporal alignment and speaker-utterance ambiguity in multi-speaker settings. To overcome these limitations, we propose CineDub, a unified diffusion-based model that achieves precise multi-speaker dialogue dubbing directly from uncropped videos, without face cropping or speaker diarization. Central to our approach is the Implicitly-Coupled Holistic Conditioning (ICHC) paradigm, where holistic visual representations and a semantic-bundled transcription format are encoded independently, yet implicitly coupled through cross-modal training to resolve speaker ambiguity and enable precise multi-speaker multi-turn dialogue dubbing. Building on the unified temporal cues captured by holistic visual features, we further extend CineDub to joint speech and audio generation. We introduce an Ambient-to-Linguistic Curriculum Learning (ALC) to mitigate sub-task degradation, and a decoupled textual branch control mechanism to resolve cross-prompt interference during simultaneous generation. We also release two in-the-wild benchmarks, CineDub-Multi for multi-speaker dialogue dubbing and CineDub-SA for video-to-speech-and-audio (V2SA) generation, to enable evaluation under realistic conditions. Experiments show that CineDub achieves state-of-the-art results on established single-speaker dubbing and video-to-audio benchmarks while excelling in multi-speaker dialogue dubbing and acoustically coherent joint generation.

papers.title_en: MDwAIstScheduler: Bringing On-Device Voice Documentation into Clinical Practice
papers.evidence: 基于语音识别与语言模型的端侧临床语音记录系统
papers.tldr: 临床文档记录长期迫使医生在患者与键盘之间分心，大量工作甚至占用下班时间。本系统提供一种低成本腰带佩戴式管道，让医生在诊间自然说话，即可完成医学自动语音识别与临床动作提取。整个流程完全在设备端运行，使用医学自动语音识别模型和微调过的十七亿参数语言模型，将药物、过敏、检查、随访等结果生成为结构化草稿，直接写入电子病历供医生确认。它去除了键盘工作，让医生专注于患者照护，同时降低工作负担。
papers.abstract_en: Clinical documentation forces physicians to split attention between the patient and their keyboard, and much of it spills into uncom- pensated after-hours work. We present MDwAIstScheduler, a low- cost, belt-worn pipeline that lets a physician speak naturally dur- ing the encounter and have the resulting medications, allergies, labs/orders/referrals, follow-up scheduling, vitals, and problems land in the EHR as review-ready drafts. Building on our earlier prototype, which relied on cloud speech recognition and a cloud language model, the current pipeline runs both transcription and intent extraction entirely on-device. Using a medical-domain auto- matic speech recognition (ASR) model and a 1.7B-parameter lan- guage model we fine-tuned for clinical action extraction, no patient audio or text leaves the device, and the structured drafts are written directly into the Elation EHR for the physician to confirm. The result is a documentation tool that removes keyboard work from the visit without removing the clinician from the record, allowing them to focus on what matters most, patient care, while reducing burden at the same time.

papers.title_en: ARENA: Automated Red-Teaming for Large Audio Language Models
papers.authors: Jiaming He, Zhicong Huang, Tian Jin, Zhen Sun, Cheng Hong, Yi Yu, Wenbo Jiang, Xudong Jiang
papers.evidence: 面向音频红队测试的基准与数据集
papers.tldr: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）通过语音等音频输入扩展了交互方式，但文本-only红队难以发现其安全漏洞。本文提出ARENA闭环框架，训练控制器生成音频-文本联合输入，利用MD-Judge提供训练奖励和反馈，配合Llama Guard 3评估结果。在四个主流LALM上，攻击成功率最高达100%，且消融实验证明反馈优化与音频变体搜索显著提升攻击发现能力。该工作为LALM安全评估提供了自动化音频红队方案。
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) make it possible to interact with language models through speech, music, and environmental sound, but they also introduce a safety surface that is difficult to expose with text-only red-teaming. We study automated audio-grounded red-teaming, where a text query must remain safe in isolation while the joint text-audio input induces harmful target behavior. We propose ARENA, a closed-loop framework that trains a controller on an independent 2,000case text-audio dataset. MD-Judge supplies training rewards and adaptive search feedback, while a separate, non-adaptive Llama Guard 3 evaluator alone labels final outcomes. On 520 held-out AdvBench objectives, ARENA achieves FDR/PSR of 87.9/100.0%, 71.5/96.3%, 68.1/100.0%, and 75.4/98.5% on Audio Flamingo 3, Qwen2-Audio, MiMo-Audio, and GPTAudio, respectively. Ablations show that feedback-based refinement and audio-variant search substantially improve attack discovery.

papers.title_en: Target Speaker Identification: A Low-Latency Streaming Pipeline
papers.authors: Patrick S. Burke, Satyam Raj, Sean Kinahan
papers.evidence: 流式说话人日志与验证的低延迟音频处理
papers.tldr: 面向助听器低延迟应用，提出一个基于开源预训练模型的流式目标说话人识别流水线。流程首先使用低延迟流式说话人分割（Diart）对输入音频进行实时分段，随后通过说话人验证（Pyannote）与注册目标进行匹配。系统在This American Life播客数据上，以主持人作为目标进行评测，在17集音频上达到超过0.90的中位准确率和0.95-0.98的特异性。实验结果验证了该流水线满足低延迟要求，为助听器选择性放大提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: We present a real-time pipeline of open source, pretrained models for streaming identification of a target speaker, motivated by hearing-aid applications where latency as low as 10 ms can be perceptible. We formulate a two-step approach in which incoming audio is first segmented by speaker using low-latency streaming diarization, followed by speaker verification against a registered target speaker. To emulate conversational speech while minimizing overlap, we use the This American Life Podcast Transcripts dataset and select the host as a consistent target speaker. We benchmark offline diarization with Pyannote and LIUM using diarization error rate (DER) and select Pyannote based on baseline performance and compatibility with streaming. We then evaluate speaker verification using Pyannote and TitaNet-Large and generate ROC curves to select an operating region. We integrate Diart and tune clustering parameters to reduce DER while maintaining real-time operation. We pair Diart with Pyannote verification and evaluate system-level performance by converting predicted and ground-truth speech regions into 100 ms binary masks. Across 17 evaluation episodes, the system achieves greater than 0.90 median accuracy with high specificity (0.95-0.98) at cosine distance thresholds of 0.7-0.75, demonstrating a practical proof of concept for downstream low-latency selective amplification.
